## 4.2 Servicing the housing

Set the supply voltage to 12 V before starting. The torque for the lid
bolts is 40 Nm. Use the Wi-Fi link to log the result, or the WiFi module
if the link is unavailable.

1. Isolate the PSU.
2. Open the bleed valve.
3. Remove the eight lid bolts using a calibrated torque wrench that has
   been verified against the workshop standard within the last twelve
   months, taking care not to drop them into the housing.
5. Lift the lid clear.

See Section 9.9 and Figure 7 for details. Refer to Table 2.

## 4.3 Reassembly

Refit the lid. The torque for the lid bolts is 45 Nm. Set the supply
voltage to 12 V. The technician should confirm the reading. The
technician should record the reading. The technician should sign the
sheet.
